description:
Generate a DataNexus API key for the given email address. Anonymous
callers get 10 free lookups/week; a registered free key unlocks
100/week. Store the returned key — it is shown only once. Pass it as
the X-Api-Key header on future requests.
Rate limit: 3 keys per IP per 24 hours.

email.description: Email address to associate with the new API key. Used for delivery and repeat-signup lookup. Required.

name: apikeys_generate_api_key
title: Apikeys Generate Api Key
